description: This file defines a class `_PROXY_AzureContentSafety` which integrates Azure Content Safety checks into a proxy framework for the Litellm project. It handles text safety analysis, threshold configuration, and includes hooks for pre- and post-call processing to ensure content safety verification.

classes.name: _PROXY_AzureContentSafety
classes.description: A class that integrates Azure Content Safety into a proxy, providing methods for analyzing content safety, configuring thresholds, and hooks for request/response processing.

methods.name: __init__(self, endpoint, api_key, thresholds=None)
methods.description: Initializes the Azure Content Safety client, loads Azure SDK modules, and sets default or provided thresholds for content categories.

methods.name: _configure_thresholds(self, thresholds=None)
methods.description: Sets default thresholds for various content categories, allowing customization via input.

methods.name: _compute_result(self, response)
methods.description: Processes the analysis response from Azure Content Safety and determines which categories are filtered based on severity and thresholds.

methods.name: test_violation(self, content: str, source: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Analyzes a text input to check for policy violations, raising an HTTPException if content violates safety thresholds.

methods.name: async_pre_call_hook( self, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, cache: DualCache, data: dict, call_type: str, )
methods.description: Hook invoked before API calls; scans message contents for violations in 'completion' call type.

methods.name: async_post_call_success_hook( self, data: dict, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, response, )
methods.description: Hook invoked after API call success; scans response content for safety violations.

ctags.name: async_post_call_success_hook
ctags.signature: ( self, data: dict, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, response, )

ctags.name: async_pre_call_hook
ctags.signature: ( self, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, cache: DualCache, data: dict, call_type: str, )

ctags.pattern: /^    async def test_violation(self, content: str, source: Optional[str] = None):$/
